name: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Ltd.
business_summary: Navratna PSU holding the monopoly on online railway ticketing (convenience fees), railway catering, Rail Neer packaged water and tourism. TTM sales Rs 5,425 cr, EBITDA margin ~31% (falling from 47% in FY22 as low-margin catering grows), PAT Rs 1,393 cr, almost debt-free, dividend yield 2.0%, government owns 62.4% with a planned FY27 OFS. The stock is at 2020 levels, -36% in 12 months, de-rating on slowing earnings growth and railway-PSU sentiment.

exposures.mechanism: Internet ticketing convenience fees (~25% of revenue, ~60% segment margin) plus catering/tourism track passenger volumes. +10% travel demand -> ticketing/tourism volume +6% -> EBITDA +6% (33% margin, ~50% incremental); EV/MCap 0.85 (net cash); persistence 0.8 -> ~+4.

evidence.note: Q1 FY27 sales 1,370 cr, OPM 28%, PAT 330 cr; mcap 36,720 cr, P/E 26.6

exposures.mechanism: Convenience fees (~Rs 1,300 cr, ~85% margin) are set by the Railway Board. A 25% cut = EBITDA -18% (persistence 1.0, EV/MCap 0.85 -> -15), weighted by an assumed ~40% chance of a binding tightening step per +1 unit -> -6.

evidence.note: Convenience-fee structure historically changed by Railways

exposures.mechanism: Catering (~45% of revenue per model knowledge) operates on licence fees/pass-through, but Q1 catering revenue +34% has thinner margin; food/packaging input +2pp -> catering margin -30 bp of segment -> EBITDA -1.3% -> persistence 0.3 -> -0.4; plus tariff caps -> -0.8. Pack wheat +0.87 (t 1.4) opposite sign, insignificant.

evidence.note: Q1 revenue +18% to Rs1,369.5 cr; PAT flat; catering revenue +34%; govt plans FY27 OFS (Upstox/Sahi/Moneycontrol)

exposures.mechanism: Debt-free with Rs 3,000+ cr treasury (model knowledge) so +25bp lifts interest income slightly (+0.4%) but dividend-yield stock (2.0%, P/E 26.6) is rate-sensitive: net -1.0. Pack Fed funds +2.75 (t 2.1) is not a causal channel (likely correlated PSU-rally).

evidence.note: Q1 FY27 sales 1,370 cr, OPM 28%, PAT 330 cr; mcap 36,720 cr, P/E 26.6

exposures.mechanism: Escalation led to rail travel restrictions/diversions in May 2025 (model knowledge); border-region trains cancelled, tourism bookings cut; -1% to -3% revenue in a quarter, EBITDA -3% -> -2 incl. PSU risk-off.

Sentiment co-movement with the railway PSU basket (RVNL, IRFC, IRCON; Livemint 17 Oct: whole group down ~40% in a year). Fundamental link is weak: passenger numbers rise with capacity (Vande Bharat etc.); +10% capex -> +0.5% passenger capacity, plus basket flow +0.7. Low confidence.

evidence.note: Livemint: railway PSU stocks down 40% in a year

exposures.mechanism: Rail Neer (~9% of revenue) uses PET resin/packaging ~30% of its cost; +10% -> +0.25% of revenue -> EBITDA -1% -> persistence 0.3 -> -0.3.
FIIs only 3.5% (from 4.9%) and falling; PSU consumer name has low FPI sensitivity; +1.0.

evidence.note: Q1 FY27 sales 1,370 cr, OPM 28%, PAT 330 cr; mcap 36,720 cr, P/E 26.6

exposures.mechanism: Rail travel and tourism volumes scale with GDP/income: +1pp GDP -> volumes +1.2% -> EBITDA +1.5% -> persistence 0.8, plus beta 1.3 -> +2.5.

evidence.note: Q1 FY27 sales 1,370 cr, OPM 28%, PAT 330 cr; mcap 36,720 cr, P/E 26.6
